easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters untapped due to Spelunking, Selesnya Sanctuary and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {G}{W}.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

uses.name: Springheart Nantuko
uses.cardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya
